title: Vinyume vya Nomino (Theme 9: Afya bora)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child gives the noun of the opposite meaning, not a related word and not a negative.
steps: Find the noun with the opposite meaning.
Check it is not a near word.
contexts: guests and hosts at a party

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "usiku" and two more pairs.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kinyume cha "usiku" ni ___." Kwa nini "jioni" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kinyume ni neno lenye maana kinyume kabisa: usiku-mchana. "Jioni" iko karibu na usiku lakini si kinyume.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kinyume cha "furaha" ni ___." Kwa nini "raha" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: "Raha" ina maana sawa na furaha. Kinyume cha furaha ni huzuni.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kinyume cha "mgeni" ni ___." Kwa nini "rafiki" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Mgeni ni anayetembelea, na mwenyeji ni anayepokea. Ni vinyume.
Kinyume cha nomino ni nomino nyingine: rafiki, adui.
